name: iphone-use
description: Wireless iPhone control for Codex with a direct WebDriverAgent connection; no Appium Server required.

interface.shortDescription: Control your iPhone over Wi-Fi with direct WDA.
interface.longDescription: Operate a real iPhone wirelessly from Codex through a direct WebDriverAgent connection. After initial pairing and signing with your own Apple account, unplug USB for everyday use. Requires a Mac, Xcode, a prepared wireless tunnel, and an unlocked iPhone on the same reachable network. No Appium Server or separate model API key is required.
defaultPrompt: Set up iphone-use-wireless for wireless control on this Mac.
Use iphone-use-wireless to connect to my iPhone over Wi-Fi and read its current screen.
